paragraphs: Rabbah bar Mattana. Shabbat 21, end of a. Abaye, Rava, R’ Zeira, and Rabbah bar Mattana sat together. The ensuing question was whether R’ Zeira, who was sharp and raised objections, or Rabbah bar Rav Mattana, who was deliberate and drew conclusions, was preferable. The question remains unresolved (Horayot 14a). Abaye and R’ Hanina, sons of Avin, studied in Rabbah’s academy. The checked Pesahim 34a reads Rav Hananya and names Rava bar Mattana as the one who approached them.
